item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\ncases=[({'from':'x','to':'y'},{'edges':{}},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'bad','attempts':0},{'edges':{'a>b':{'role':'good','retry':True}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'good','attempts':True},{'edges':{'a>b':{'role':'good','retry':True}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':0},{'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':2},{'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})]\\nfor req,pol,want in cases:\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==want,(got,want); assert req==rb and pol==pb\\npolicy=json.load(open('policy.json')); requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); assert report==[evaluate(x,policy) for x in requests]\\nschema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json')); assert all(set(x)==set(schema['required']) for x in report)\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}"}
